words.note: 高度專門的實驗室用語。aliquot 指從較大液體或材料樣本中量取的一部分，通常體積／數量精確，用於分析或不同測試。它不是一般 sample 的通用同義詞。
words.example: A 5 ml aliquot was transferred to a clean tube.

exercises.original: A 10 ml sample was taken from the mixed solution for the next assay.
exercises.zh: 從混合溶液中取出十毫升等分樣本進行下一項分析。
exercises.upgrade: aliquot · 等分樣本；定量分取樣本

options.explanation: 10 ml + solution + assay 明確是定量分取的實驗室 aliquot。
特別為測試、質檢或分析而抽取的樣品。 但本題的具體線索是 a precisely measured 10 ml portion for an assay；本句有 ml、pipetted、equal portions、assay 等精確實驗室分取線索。 因此 test sample 不是最佳答案。

布料、顏色、牆紙、皮革等用來比較的小樣。 但本題的具體線索是 a precisely measured 10 ml portion for an assay；本句有 ml、pipetted、equal portions、assay 等精確實驗室分取線索。 因此 swatch 不是最佳答案。

exercises.original: The technician divided the prepared sample into several equal samples for separate tests.
exercises.zh: 技術員把準備好的樣本分成數個等分樣本作不同測試。
exercises.upgrade: aliquot · 等分樣本；定量分取樣本

exercises.original: A small sample of the serum was pipetted into each reaction tube.
exercises.zh: 少量血清等分樣本被移液至每個反應管。
exercises.upgrade: aliquot · 等分樣本；定量分取樣本

options.explanation: pipetted + serum + reaction tube 是高度典型實驗室 aliquot 語境。
特別為測試、質檢或分析而抽取的樣品。 但本題的具體線索是 serum pipetted into reaction tubes；本句有 ml、pipetted、equal portions、assay 等精確實驗室分取線索。 因此 test sample 不是最佳答案。

falseSynonyms.zh: specimen 更強調為觀察、辨識或檢驗而取得的一個實體標本；sample 的範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lab received a blood specimen. The survey used a sample of 500 residents.

falseSynonyms.zh: example 是用來說明某類特徵的例子；sample 也可以是物質、統計、實驗樣本。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON This paragraph is a good example of formal style. A water sample was sent to the laboratory.

falseSynonyms.zh: test sample 明確表示這份材料是為測試／質檢而抽取；不是所有 sample 都有測試用途。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A test sample was taken from the batch. The exhibition presents a sample of student work.

falseSynonyms.zh: subset 只表示較大集合中的一部分；sample 往往還有抽樣、代表或測試功能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The model used a subset of the dataset. The researchers drew a representative sample.

falseSynonyms.zh: selection 強調經挑選的一組項目；統計 sample 則通常涉及抽樣方法與母體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The gallery displays a selection of photographs. The survey used a random sample of households.

falseSynonyms.zh: excerpt 只適合文字、演講、錄音等較長內容中的一小段。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The book contains an excerpt from the diary. The laboratory tested a soil sample.

falseSynonyms.zh: swatch 只適合布料、顏色、牆紙等視覺／材質小樣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She chose a fabric swatch. The doctor collected a blood sample.

falseSynonyms.zh: sample 是抽取出的樣本；sampling 是抽樣這個過程／方法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The sample included 800 households. Random sampling was used to select them.
